You can cancel the deletion by contacting Steam Support during the 30 days. You can't reuse your account name.

While account deletion will go through, it will NOT delete your messages, which you must do manually, or by following this tutorial to ask for deletion of your messages, which requires that you first request your data package: [discorch.org](https://discorch.org). Your account must stay active while awaiting Discord's response. NOTE: Discord will only delete any of your messages in servers and group DMs that you are not a member of; 1-1 DMs must be manually deleted, or automated through same the link above. If you are an owner of any servers, you must either [delete it](https://support.discord.com/hc/articles/213595197), or [transfer ownership](https://support.discord.com/hc/articles/216273938) before you are able to delete your account.
